limitations: The headline and reconciliation tables put 2024 before 2025 and the relevant 2025 three-month value at numeric index 1; the GAAP appendix puts 2025 first at index 0. Six-/nine-month cumulative columns are excluded.

Adjusted income from operations is company-defined non-GAAP and must not be equated with GAAP net income. The selected reconciliation total equals the sum of listed signed components; the subsidiary-sale line is shown as an em dash in both current 2025 quarters and is not separately recorded as an audited numeric zero.

GAAP revenue rose while GAAP net income and adjusted income from operations declined. The GAAP-to-adjusted gap narrowed sharply; signed fair-value/reinsurance and other-items adjustment components changed substantially, but this selected bridge does not prove their recurrence or economic cause.
Preferred dividends are a signed deduction in the selected appendix. A larger deduction contributes to the larger decline in common-stockholder diluted income than in consolidated net income.
Selected rows do not audit every segment, reserve assumption, investment portfolio exposure, capital adequacy, or all reconciliation footnotes.

reviews.rationale: Selected-row sequential comparison only; no year-over-year, guidance, or causal claim is made. Both GAAP and company-defined adjusted earnings measures moved lower sequentially while GAAP revenues moved higher, so the selected rows do not establish whether the earnings decline reflects operating margin pressure, a revenue-mix effect, or items outside the company-defined adjusted measure. The reconciliation total adjustments shrank sharply, with the fair value reinsurance-related component and other items turning negative and only partly offset by smaller investment losses and a smaller tax expense on adjustments; the selected rows do not decompose these components or explain their drivers. Preferred dividends declared increased in magnitude, which affects the common-holder subtotals but is not itself an operating result. Because the selected extract lacks segment detail, investment-income and spread detail, actuarial assumption updates, guidance, and any management explanation, the direction of the underlying earnings trend and its persistence cannot be determined from this evidence. Research state is therefore held for review rather than upgraded or invalidated; conviction and status are unchanged and the thesis remains blocked pending a complete filing and management discussion.
